claim: Shows client commitment, committed subcontractor cost, and expected margin in one job chain
where: landing preview, demo margin check, README
sandbox: fresh /demo workspace; open Autumn launch films; assert $24,000 - $14,500 = $9,500 and 39.6%

claim: Names the committed cost that puts expected margin below the job's floor
where: demo job register, margin check, README
sandbox: fresh /demo workspace; add a $6,000 commitment; assert the alert names it and reports a $1,300 floor shortfall

claim: Keeps scope approval and client invoice status beside the same job
where: landing steps, demo job workspace, README
sandbox: fresh /demo workspace; approve scope and mark its client invoice milestone sent; reload and assert both states remain

claim: The demo creates a job chain, adds a cost, approves scope, updates an invoice state, and resets the sample
sandbox: fresh /demo workspace; perform every named action and assert reset restores exactly three original jobs

claim: The demo starts with three original fictional Northline Studio jobs
sandbox: fresh /demo workspace; assert the three exact fixture IDs and names plus the repository provenance record

claim: The sample demo needs no account
sandbox: fresh browser context; open /?demo=1; assert the seeded register works without CIAM, billing, or an account gate

claim: Demo changes are discarded when the sample is reset
sandbox: fresh /demo workspace; add a cost, reset, assert original values return, and assert the old workspace is rejected

claim: Each demo workspace is isolated and expires within 24 hours
sandbox: create two API contexts; mutate one; assert the other is unchanged and expiry is no more than 24 hours

claim: The public and demo flow makes no cross-origin requests
sandbox: record every request through landing, demo, and a mutation; assert only the product origin is used

claim: Maps CSV columns and previews every row before importing valid job chains
sandbox: fresh /demo/import; load the bundled CSV; assert two dry-run rows and no errors; import and assert both jobs appear

claim: Exports all current demo job chains as local CSV or JSON downloads
sandbox: fresh /demo workspace; download CSV and JSON; assert headings, three records, exact fixture ID, and no export request

claim: The demo does not calculate tax, decide worker status, collect money, or send invoices
sandbox: inspect demo controls and response keys; assert prohibited capabilities are absent while invoice state marking remains

claim: Planned Studio pricing is $79 monthly for 25 active job chains and Portfolio is $159 monthly for 100 active job chains
sandbox: fresh landing page; assert both planned prices, both active-job limits, and no purchase action

claim: A host-only HttpOnly cookie identifies the demo workspace and is Secure on HTTPS
sandbox: provision through simulated HTTPS ingress; assert Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, and no Domain attribute

claim: Demo workspaces persist across application replicas through a shared durable store
sandbox: two application states share a durable store; create on one, read and mutate on the other, then read the change on the first

claim: The server starts with only PORT and defaults to port 8080
sandbox: spawn the built server with a cleared environment and only PORT, then assert /health returns 200

claim: Web responses include the product security-header policy
sandbox: request landing and assert CSP, HSTS, MIME, referrer, permissions, and frame protections

claim: Demo API routes enforce shared request limits using the ingress client address
sandbox: alternate requests across two replicas; exceed allowances; assert 429 and Retry-After

claim: Retrying the same create returns its saved result without adding another record
sandbox: send 12 concurrent retries across two replicas; assert one 201, eleven 200 responses, and one new cost

claim: Rejected requests return structured problem details
sandbox: send invalid and oversized requests; assert problem media type, stable code, request ID, field guidance, and 64 KiB bound

claim: Every demo API response, including errors, uses Cache-Control: no-store
sandbox: assert a successful response and a rejected response both carry Cache-Control: no-store

claim: Money uses integer cents and percentage floors round upward to the next cent when needed
sandbox: calculate a 25% floor on 10,001 cents; assert integer inputs and outputs plus the 2,501-cent upward result

claim: The health response reports the build SHA supplied during the image build
test: BUILD_SHA=claim-build-0123456789 cargo test --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml --test health claim_health_reports_build_identity --locked
sandbox: compile with claim-build-0123456789 and assert /health returns that exact identity

claim: Unknown page addresses return HTTP 404
sandbox: request an unknown path and assert HTTP 404 with the designed recovery page

claim: Hashed production assets use immutable caching
sandbox: request a hashed asset and assert one-year immutable Cache-Control

claim: The service exposes JSON readiness and Prometheus metrics endpoints
sandbox: assert /ready returns JSON 200 and /internal/metrics returns Prometheus text
